resources.string: Language, translation and subtitle look are saved for this tab only. Accounts, AI keys and the chat stay shared.
These settings are copied into each new tab. Tabs you already have, and the video that is playing, do not change.
Reset this tab to the default
The language, translation and subtitle look of this tab are replaced with the Default for new tabs. Other tabs do not change.
Use the settings of this tab as the default
The Default for new tabs becomes a copy of the settings of this tab, including dragged positions, play modes and the AI model. Tabs you already have do not change.
